Most refreshes then cost only row-bus capacity, which is spare." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=12.5;fontColor=#16202c;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="60" y="264" width="960" height="104" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="cred" value="Refresh credit (ref_debt)&#10;JEDEC allows +/- 8 refreshes of slack.&#10;&#10; debt < 0 opportunistic - only when free&#10; 0 .. 5 normal priority in the row arbiter&#10; >= 6 URGENT - taken unconditionally" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=12;fontColor=#16202c;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="60" y="396" width="460" height="116" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="stag" value="Global phase assignment&#10;256 pseudo-channels refreshing together is a&#10;correlated current spike and a correlated&#10;bandwidth notch.&#10;&#10;The supervisor gives each PC a fixed offset of&#10;(global_pc_index x tREFI) / 256. Costs nothing." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontColor=#16202c;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="560" y="396" width="460" height="116" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="ttl" value="Figure 12 - Per-bank refresh keeps the stream running" style="text;html=1;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="12" width="1040" height="26" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.text: Figure 12 - Per-bank refresh keeps the stream running
All-bank refresh stalls a whole pseudo-channel. Per-bank refresh takes out one bank of 32 while the other 31 keep streaming.
tRFCab ~ 350 ns, blocks the ENTIRE pseudo-channel
= 11 KB of lost bandwidth per event
the column stream continues on the other 31
In steady state 31 of 32 banks are open and streaming, and each goes briefly idle when its row is exhausted.
The engine tracks those windows and refreshes a bank that was ABOUT TO BE PRECHARGED ANYWAY, merging
PRE -> REF into one row-bus slot pair. Most refreshes then cost only row-bus capacity, which is spare.
0 .. 5 normal priority in the row arbiter
correlated current spike and a correlated
